name: WhatsApp (via EVO)
description: WhatsApp through the EVO platform (Evolution API 2.x): the controller forwards events, this plugin answers customer messages with the agent and replies via EVO.

whatsapp-evo.label: WhatsApp (via EVO)
whatsapp-evo.description: EVO endpoint + credentials written into openclaw.json by the controller at bind time.

evoBaseUrl.label: EVO base URL
evoBaseUrl.help: Evolution API base URL, e.g. https://ev-api.example.com. Written by the controller at bind time.

evoApiKey.label: EVO API key
evoApiKey.help: Evolution API global key. Stored in the instance's openclaw.json only 閳?never logged.

evoInstanceId.label: EVO instance name
evoInstanceId.help: Fallback EVO instance name. Normally taken from the X-Evo-Instance header on inbound requests.

dmPolicy.label: DM policy
dmPolicy.help: open replies to everyone (requires allowFrom to contain "*"); pairing/allowlist restrict senders.

allowFrom.label: Allowed senders
allowFrom.help: Use ["*"] together with dmPolicy "open". An absent list plus pairing silently blocks every customer.
